### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

### Motivation & Problem Statement
Why is this feature needed? What security use case does it solve?

### Proposed Architecture & Solution
Describe how this feature should fit into ARKA's modular architecture:
- Event Ingestion / Processing
- Detection Engine & Rules
- Incident Management
- SOC Dashboard UI

### Technical Impact & Considerations
- Database schema changes?
- OpenSearch mapping updates?
- Security & tenant isolation impact?
